semiconductor_relevance: High — MB Automation GmbH & Co. KG is deeply involved in semiconductor backend applications with advanced packaging solutions and automation systems.
summary: MB Automation GmbH & Co. KG provides advanced packaging solutions and automation systems for semiconductor backend applications. Their offerings include die sorting, AI-supported vision inspection, and smart carrier tape, all designed to enhance production efficiency and ensure die-level traceability. They also offer manufacturing software and simulation tools to optimize production processes.
